site.title: Harbourlight Contact | Customer support teams in Cebu
site.description: Harbourlight Contact runs voice, chat and email support teams in Cebu for healthcare, retail, logistics and fintech companies.

data.title: Customer support teams for *growing service brands*
data.lead: Harbourlight Contact runs voice, chat and email support from Cebu for healthcare, retail, logistics and fintech companies, with one team lead for every program.

cards.title: Voice support
cards.text: Inbound calls for orders, bookings, billing questions and account changes, answered in your scripts and tone.

cards.title: Chat and email
cards.text: Written support with templates your team approves and weekly quality reviews on a sample of tickets.

cards.title: Back-office tasks
cards.text: Refunds, order updates and account checks handled inside your tools by trained processors.

cards.title: Reporting
cards.text: A weekly report on volume, response time and quality scores, reviewed with your program owner.

head.title: Industries we serve
head.lead: Each sector has its own training track and a team lead who has run programs in it before.

items.title: Healthcare
items.text: Appointment booking, benefits questions and claims intake for clinics and health plans.

photo.alt: Doctor and nurse talking with a patient at a desk

items.title: Retail and ecommerce
items.text: Order tracking, returns and delivery questions for online stores during normal and peak seasons.

photo.alt: Person packing a parcel at a work table

items.title: Logistics
items.text: Shipment status, delivery changes and driver support for courier and freight companies.

items.title: Fintech
items.text: Card questions, onboarding checks and payment disputes for lenders and payment apps.

aside.title: Have a question about your program?
aside.text: A team lead can walk you through staffing, training and reporting for your queue.

photo.alt: Harbourlight support agent working at a desk with two monitors

items.q: How are agents trained for our program?
items.a: New agents learn your products and tools on real tickets with a trainer before they take live contacts on their own.

items.q: Can we listen to calls and read tickets?
items.a: Yes. You get access to the same quality reviews our team leads use, and you can join the weekly review.

items.q: Which channels can one team cover?
items.a: One team can answer calls, chats and emails. Most programs start with one channel and add the others later.

items.q: Who is our contact at Harbourlight?
items.a: Every program has one team lead who handles staffing, training and the weekly report.

form.title: Tell us about your support queue
form.text: Share your channels, hours and monthly volume.
form.success_text: A team lead will reply by email to set up a call.
